families.finding: All 84 registered box-kite bright-minus-dark contrasts reject the null under family-wise Hoeffding bounds (estimates +0.282 to +0.731). The separately registered depth-4 class-return contrast does not reject: -0.0101 [-0.0848, +0.0645].

All 8 sector bright-minus-dark-at-one contrasts reject the null (estimates +0.612 to +0.868), and all 12 pulse-difference laws in sectors 4-7 reject it: t1d2-t0d1 zero-two pulse +0.435 to +0.486, t3d2-t2d1 zero-two pulse +0.249 to +0.276, t1d2-t1d1 one-two pulse +0.111 to +0.126.

Known-label correction beats measured-bit correction on s3 in both runs (gain +0.0132, +0.0209; lower bounds -0.0077, -0.0006) and not on s1; about 11 percent of shots misread the first bit, and measured-bit correction then applies the wrong phase.
